project: Altsasu Manifa — Unity HDRP open world

terrain_script_analysis.heightmap_source: lidar_dtm_05m.raw (2049x2049 uint16 LE), with XYZ, ASC and fallback RAW fallbacks
terrain_script_analysis.resampling_method: Catmull-Rom 4x4 kernel applied per-pixel, clamps edges
terrain_script_analysis.rmse_details: 2000 random ground truth points from lidar_ground.xyz, threshold 0.3m
terrain_script_analysis.gaussian_correction_details: Local Gaussian splat r=2m on points where |error| > rmse*0.5 after RMSE validation
terrain_script_analysis.mountain_fusion_details: Gaussian border blend (200m) from LIDAR area into DTM 5m IGN for terrain outside LIDAR bounds
terrain_script_analysis.coordinate_system: UTM 30N ETRS89 origin at Herriko Plaza E=567951 N=4749902, Unity offset OX=1918 OZ=8570, 1unit=1m
issues_found: GetH() normalizes raw altitude using 0 as min instead of Z_MIN (511.33m): `(altM - 0f) / terY` should be `(altM - Z_MIN) / terY`, causing heightmap to be shifted by ~511m / terY in normalized space. This is the most critical bug.
SampleASCUTM normalizes with raw z/terY ignoring Z_MIN offset — same class of bug for DTM 5m path
AplicarDesdeXYZ: fill-holes loop uses only 4-connected neighbors over 4 iterations — sparse LIDAR areas may still have unfilled holes
GaussianBlend uses exp(-t^2*3) which reaches ~95% at t=1, meaning the blend zone never fully reaches LIDAR weight at the interior edge (minor smoothing artifact)
NativeArray<ushort> _lidarRaw is Persistent but only freed in OnDestroy — if the GO is re-used in Editor without play-mode exit, memory leaks accumulate
TerrainData.size.y is assumed to be the full real altitude range, but its actual value depends on SceneBootstrapper config — no runtime assertion checks this
missing_features: No multi-terrain support (assumes single Terrain.activeTerrain)
No terrain chunk stitching for large worlds beyond 1024m
DSM (dsm_alsasua_5m.asc) is present in AlsasuaData but never used — could improve building footprint relief
No runtime heightmap streaming / progressive LOD (terrain always at full 2049 resolution)
No snow layer integration (SistemaTerreno adjusts altitudRocaM but does not actually apply a snow texture channel)
lidar_agua.json loaded but LIDAR water points are logged and then discarded — not used to adjust excavation heights

ortophoto_analysis.streaming_details: Camera-distance based, 1s polling interval, max 2 tiles loaded per tick, unload at 1.5x radius
ortophoto_analysis.quad_placement: Flat quads at terrain height + 0.05m offset, isStatic=true
issues_found: Each tile creates a NEW Material instance per load (CrearMat creates `new Material(_shader)`) causing shader variant proliferation and memory pressure — should use MaterialPropertyBlock or shared material with per-tile texture
AlturaTerreno() called once at tile creation time for quad Y positioning — if terrain heightmap is modified later (by GeneradorRiosYPuentes excavation) tiles will float above river beds
No async/threaded texture loading — File.ReadAllBytes is called on main thread, then LoadImage on main thread; for 72 tiles this can spike frame time
streaming_radius default 400m covers ~4 tiles; at 330m tile size this may leave the player at the visible boundary of uncovered ground
Tiles are isStatic=true but loaded/unloaded at runtime — static batching may conflict or be invalidated
No mipmap generation (mipChain:false) — ortofoto will alias heavily at distance, especially on terrain slopes
missing_features: No terrain basemap baking — ortofoto floats above terrain as quads rather than being baked into TerrainData.terrainLayers as a splat channel or basemap
No prioritized load order (closest tiles first within streaming radius)
No LOD / downscaled version for distant tiles
No Texture2D.Compress() call after LoadImage — tiles stay uncompressed RGB24 in GPU VRAM (~6.6MB each, 72 tiles = up to 475MB if all loaded)
tiles/orto/ subdirectory path hardcoded — no validation that tile files exist before creating GameObjects

vegetation_analysis.tree_count_source: lidar_trees.json (LIDAR class 5), supplemented by procedural fill from masas_forestales.geojson
vegetation_analysis.burst_job_details: JobMarcarArbolesADestruir, JobFiltrarArbolesEnRango, JobComprobarOcupacion — all IJobParallelFor with Persistent NativeArrays
issues_found: OSM fallback path (CargarPosicionesOSM) uses Resources.Load with a path string derived from rutaJSON — the path manipulation is brittle and will silently fail in builds
BucleSteaming() polling interval is 2s — at 800m radius and player moving at 30m/s, trees may pop in with noticeable delay
ClasificarEspecie() calls GeneradorRiosYPuentes.Instance.DistanciaAlRio() which iterates all segments per tree — O(n*m) per streaming cycle for thousands of trees

Pool pre-warming only uses treePrefabs[0..tamañoPool-1] — species-specific prefabs (prefabsRoble, prefabsPino, prefabsRibera) are NOT pooled, so AlquilarArbol() creates new instances for those species
go.isStatic = false on streaming tree instances — correct for dynamic objects but disables GPU instancing batching; consider enabling GPU instancing on materials instead
MAX_CANDIDATOS = 200 is a hard cap per streaming cycle — in dense forest areas this may starve visible tree slots
No wind animation integration with SistemaClima — trees have static rotations
missing_features: No understorey (shrubs, ferns, bracken) layer — only trees above 30m managed here
No seasonal variation (spring green / autumn orange / winter bare) per species
No impostor billboard generation at LOD5 — LOD5 distance is declared (800m) but actual impostor prefab must be set manually in Inspector
No catastro_parcelas / DSM height integration to set individual tree crown heights from LIDAR altura field
bosques.geojson present but NOT used here — only masas_forestales.geojson used for procedural fill; the two datasets may overlap causing double-density

river_analysis.excavation_details: V-asymmetric transverse profile, Arakil 8m wide 1.8m deep, arroyos 2m/0.5m, Gaussian exterior fade 1.5m
river_analysis.hdrp_water_details: HDRP/Water shader (with HDRP/Lit and Standard fallbacks), transparency, SSR smoothness 0.95, per-segment flow maps, foam on steep slopes
river_analysis.bridge_source: lidar_puentes.json, angle auto-derived from river tangent if not provided
issues_found: ParsearGeoJSON runs in a background Task but calls Terrain.activeTerrain — TerrainData access from off-thread is not thread-safe in Unity and can cause crashes or undefined data

lidar_agua.json points are loaded (logged as 'N puntos de referencia') but then explicitly NOT used: comment says 'la validación se hace en ExcavarTerrain' — but ExcavarTerrain never reads these points, so LIDAR water validation is effectively dead code
esArakil heuristic: any linestring with >50 points is classified as Arakil river — this mis-classifies long minor streams, giving them 8m width and 1.8m excavation depth
CrearMaterialAgua creates one new Material per river segment — no material batching. For long rivers with many segments this creates hundreds of draw calls
CrearFlowMap creates a new 4x4 Texture2D per river segment — these small textures are never destroyed and accumulate in VRAM

PerfilVAsimetrico asymmetry uses `pLocal.normalized` dot product but `pLocal` is relative to segment point A, not to the closest point — the asymmetry calculation is geometrically incorrect across the full segment
Coordinate ambiguity in lidar_puentes.json parser: bridges with x in range 0-5000 are assumed to already be in Unity space, but this overlaps with possible UTM-relative offsets
missing_features: No HDRP WaterSurface component usage (Unity 2022+ HDRP Water System) — water is implemented as flat quads with transparent HDRP/Lit material, missing interactive caustics, foam simulation, refraction volume, and GPU-simulated waves
No river bed material variation (rock, sand, gravel) — a single flat quad covers the full excavated channel
No dynamic flow (water velocity field, particle foam) — flowmap is a static 4x4 texture baked at startup
No seasonal water level variation (winter floods, summer low flow)
Lidar_agua.json integration is non-functional — LIDAR water class 9 points should be used to validate and adjust water plane heights segment by segment
No NavMesh obstacle marking for river areas
No audio zone for river ambiance (SistemaReverbZonas exists but no river hookup found here)

priority_improvements.improvement: Fix critical altitude normalization bug in SampleBicubicRAW: GetH() normalizes as `(altM - 0f) / terY` but should be `(altM - Z_MIN) / terY` (Z_MIN=511.33m). Same fix needed in SampleASCUTM. Without this, the entire heightmap is offset by ~511/terY in normalized space, producing incorrect mountain heights and river excavation depths.

Replace flat HDRP/Lit transparent quad water planes with Unity HDRP WaterSurface component (available in Unity 2022.2+ HDRP 14+). Add a WaterSurface per river reach with proper caustics, refraction volume, GPU simulation, and foam. Also fix the thread-safety bug: move Terrain.activeTerrain access out of the background Task in ParsearGeoJSON.

Bake ortofoto tiles into TerrainData basemap (or a dedicated Terrain Layer at index 0 with very large tileSize) instead of floating quads. This eliminates the Y-offset problem over excavated river beds, enables proper terrain shading, and removes per-tile Material instances. Use Texture2D.Compress(TextureFormat.DXT1, true) after LoadImage to reduce VRAM from ~7MB/tile to ~1.7MB/tile.

Activate lidar_agua.json integration: after ExcavarTerrain, iterate LIDAR water points to adjust individual water plane heights per segment so they match ground-truth LIDAR class 9 elevations. Fix the esArakil heuristic (do not classify by point count alone) to prevent minor streams being excavated at river scale.

Add species-specific object pools for prefabsRoble, prefabsPino, and prefabsRibera (not just treePrefabs). Reduce streaming polling from 2s to 0.5s and add a progressive instantiation budget (max N trees per frame). Integrate SistemaClima wind speed into tree material _WindMultiplier or AnimatorController to animate foliage.

Add a 9th terrain layer (or reuse channel 2 with snow tint) for winter snow accumulation above altitudRocaM. The Update() method already adjusts altitudRocaM seasonally but triggers RepintarZona on a fixed 400m patch near mountains — extend to cover the full high-altitude band and use a smooth alpha transition over 50m altitude band instead of a hard cutoff.

Implement prioritized async loading: sort tiles by distance to camera before streaming loop, use UnityWebRequest or async Task with yielded byte reading to avoid main-thread File.ReadAllBytes spikes. Add mipmap generation (mipChain:true on Texture2D, call tex.Apply(true)) to reduce GPU aliasing at distance.

Port the heightmap construction inner loop (AplicarDesdeRAW_Bicubico) to a IJobParallelFor Burst job using the existing NativeArray<ushort> _lidarRaw. This will reduce the coroutine wall time from ~5-10s (16 rows/yield) to <1s. Also add an assertion that TerrainData.size.y >= lidarMeta.terrainHeight to catch misconfigured terrain scales.

Pool or share river water materials: create one Material per unique (cauce.esArakil, pendiente_bucket) pair and assign via MaterialPropertyBlock for per-segment foam/flow variation. Likewise share the FlowMap Texture2D (same texture for same pendiente bucket). This reduces draw calls proportionally to river segment count.

Integrate bosques.geojson into the procedural fill step alongside masas_forestales.geojson, with deduplication (skip polygons whose bounding box overlaps already-processed masas_forestales polygons). Use lidar_trees.json 'altura' and 'radio' fields to scale individual tree instances rather than applying a uniform random 0.7-1.3 scale.

summary.overall_quality: Strong foundation — all major terrain subsystems exist and are architecturally sound. Primary LIDAR pipeline, 8-biome splatmap, 72-tile ortofoto streaming, 6-level LOD tree streamer with Burst jobs, and river excavation with HDRP water are all implemented.
critical_bug_descriptions: Heightmap altitude normalization does not subtract Z_MIN (511.33m) before dividing by terY — affects both SampleBicubicRAW and SampleASCUTM, producing systematically incorrect terrain heights
GeneradorRiosYPuentes.ParsearGeoJSON accesses Terrain.activeTerrain from a background Task.Run thread — thread-unsafe Unity API call that can crash or corrupt terrain data
high_impact_missing_features: HDRP WaterSurface component for physically-based river water (caustics, refraction, foam simulation)
Ortofoto baked into terrain basemap rather than floating quads
LIDAR water points (lidar_agua.json) effectively unused despite being loaded
